name: spellkave_inventory
label: Spellkave Inventory
description: Orient on the connected actor's authorized carried inventory. Unfiltered and under the bound, returns a grouped tree of top-level possessions with nested `contents` and `equipped_slot` markers. Add a kind/name_prefix filter, exceed the bound, or pass a cursor and it falls back to a flat, revision-bound paged list carrying the SAME handles the tree uses. Every response self-describes via `listing` ('complete' for the tree, 'paginated' for the flat fallback). Each item carries its OWN stable `handle`+`rev`: the SAME item keeps the SAME handle across re-reads, for as long as it exists, regardless of tree position or what else in the inventory changed. Follow up on any handle with spellkave_item_detail by copying that item's OWN `rev`+`handle` verbatim — never the envelope's top-level `rev`.

kind.description: Optional exact authored entity kind filter. Forces the flat paged list.

name_prefix.description: Optional case-insensitive item-name prefix filter. Forces the flat paged list.

limit.description: Maximum items per page, and the unfiltered grouped-tree threshold. Defaults to 50.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from a prior paged response. Forces the flat paged list.
